relations.purchase: sum(order_units * supplier_quotes.unit_price_minor), charged at order week
relations.freight: sum(truck_on * supplier_terms.freight_minor), including any empty on truck
relations.due_arrival: order week + supplier_terms.lead_weeks, unaffected by later capacity announcements
relations.supplier_volume: sum(order_units * raw_materials.volume), between minimum_volume*truck and current supplier_capacity.volume*truck
relations.raw_peak: sum((prior raw + historical due arrivals + lead0 purchases)*raw_materials.volume), before consumption
relations.finished_peak: sum((prior finished + made)*products.volume), before current delivery
relations.holding: end-week raw * raw holding + end-week finished * product holding, no salvage
relations.sales_receivable: sum(current demand.units*products.sales_price_minor), due at original delivery week + facility.receipt_lag_weeks
relations.cash: prior cash + original due historical receipts - current purchase - freight - production - holding
relations.cost: sum purchase/freight/production/holding, excludes receipts and terminal receivables
